g.text: Solid = functional + body readout, excluding abstract-only and Fig. 8a-flagged rows. Catechin, p-Coumaric acid and L-Ascorbic acid have no solid signaling-pathway assignment. All rows NOT_REVIEWED.
Sets = 8 signaling pathways; elements = compounds. Bars = compounds sharing each exact pathway combination; left bars = compounds per pathway.
UpSet - shared signaling pathways among the 12 candidates (solid evidence)
